comment: Sprint 15 Mobile & Tactical Heat (TANDEM request #14, UE-only; Survival/TacticalHeatRules.h FTacticalHeatConfig, Data/TacticalHeatTuning). Read at StartPlay; a missing key keeps the code default (Gemini's spec value). Distances in cm, times in seconds, cold in points of the 0..100 scale, turn-based costs in AP. Burn timers / gas freeze in the tactical pause (incl. the free horde pause and its flyover), in dialogues / cutscenes; in turn-based combat one squad round burns total / rounds. Console: CodexTactics.DumpTacticalHeat. Weather idle (2026-10-12, Survival/WarmIdleRules): heat-source warming x exploration / combat_warmth_multiplier (wave fight / ambush = combat); cold idle from warm_idle_cold_threshold after warm_idle_delay_seconds idle; at a campfire / stove the coldest warm_min_sitters (+ everyone >= warm_extra_sitter_cold) sit on the inner ring (*_seat_distance), the rest stand on the outer ring (*_stand_distance); barrel = standing hand warming at barrel_stand_distance. Squad gathers at the fire (2026-10-12): warm_pull_followers + warm_pull_max_distance (cm) - in exploration formation the followers walk to the ring of a barrel / campfire / stove the leader warms at. Cold idle variant (2026-10-15): at the end of each cold-idle loop clip the variant clip (Polygonmaker idle_cold) plays with cold_idle_variant_chance, at most once per cold_idle_variant_cooldown_seconds, cold_idle_variant_loops times in a row.
